**Finding: Compliant** (preferred position met — no MFN obligation on Customer).

- **No MFN burdening us.** Searches for MFN, "no less favo(u)rable", best-price and other-customer language returned nothing. The commercial terms (per-trade fee bands, time of payment, the 350,000 bonus shares and rebate shares at p0076, and the 33% Supplemental Payments revenue share at p0078) are fixed and contain no obligation for us to extend the Licensor terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers.
- **The one "other licensees" reference runs in our favour** (p0094): the Licensor must make Revisions available to us at no extra charge when it makes them generally available to its other licensees — per the detection guidance, a Vendor-granted benefit is not flagged.
- **Article XXII Right of First Refusal (p0139)** is the only third-party-matching mechanic, but it is triggered by a sale of substantially all our assets or a merger. That is a change-of-control/assignment concern rather than an MFN on commercial or pricing terms, so it is left to the change-of-control rule and not double-flagged here.

No redline proposed.
